name: comedy
premise: Everyone is behaving reasonably given what they believe, and what they believe is wrong.
obligatory_beats: a small dignified lie told to avoid a minor embarrassment
an escalation where the sensible fix is somehow unavailable
the moment the whole structure is visible to everyone at once
pacing_curve: Brisk. Set the rule, break the rule, break it again worse. Land the last beat one line earlier than expected.
sensory_palette: objects behaving badly at the worst time
food and drink at inconvenient moments
pov_distance: Slightly wider third — enough distance to see the character's dignity and the gap between it and the facts.
dialogue_register: Over-formal under pressure. People get more polite as things get worse. Specific nouns; specificity is the joke.
taboo_moves: characters who know they are funny
explaining a joke in the sentence after it
cruelty without consequence — the target must keep their dignity
whimsy standing in for a constructed situation
